compat.note: Verified openclaw range. The floor is enforced via package.json install.minHostVersion (openclaw refuses older hosts); a newer host only triggers a boot-time warning. Source of truth: @digital-me/runtime-openclaw compat.ts.

wikiRoot.description: Override DIGITAL_ME_WIKI_ROOT for this plugin instance. Defaults to the env var.

dbPath.description: Path to the brain SQLite database. Default: $DIGITAL_ME_BRAIN_DB, else <wiki-root>/.data/brain.db, else the legacy ~/.openclaw/data/brain.db while only that exists.

stallThresholdMs.description: Milliseconds of inactivity before a running task is marked stalled (default: 3600000)

scheduler.description: Run the scheduler tick in this gateway. Default: true on a gateway-only machine, false as soon as digital-me brain-host is installed (its token file exists) — brain-host is the hub and owns the tick; exactly one process may tick a brain.db. true forces the tick here; false always disables it.
